About BrowserGames100

BrowserGames100 is an independent online gaming platform dedicated to curating and hosting high-performance, web-safe browser games playable instantly without installations, accounts, or fees.

Our Mission & Values

We believe gaming should be accessible to everyone on any device. Whether using a school Chromebook, a low-spec laptop, or a smartphone, our HTML5 and WebGL games initialize in seconds inside standard web browsers.

1. Web-Safe & Family Friendly

All catalog entries are vetted to ensure they are free of malware, deceptive installers, or aggressive popup scripts. We focus on general-audience, casual, and educational titles.

2. Playability Standards

Our team verifies game controls, responsive touch layouts, and frame rate stability across Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge before featuring titles in our catalog.

3. Zero Registration Barrier

Players do not need to register, provide credit cards, or install third-party plugins. Simply choose a game, click play, and enjoy.
